skillset.skill: 11s CT - 1500% Earth DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 20. If self is not affected by status ailments, increase Arts by an additional 20.
skillset.arts: 19000% Earth DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 50. Increase Bullet Stacks by 1 (up to # of Phantom Bullet activations left). For 20s, increase ATK by 50%.
skillset.truearts: 40000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 40s, increase Allies' Earth DMG by 30% (stackable), redirect Allies' DMG taken to self and gain a DMG barrier that negates 30000 DMG to self.
skillset.phantombullet: Can be activated instead of True Arts - [# of Bullet Stacks × 50000%] Earth DMG (PHY). Reset Bullet Stacks to 1. For 40s, increase own Physical RES by 25% and gain a DMG barrier that negates 30000 to self. Phantom Bullet can only be used 6 times in a Quest. Base # of Bullet Stacks is 1. Each Bullet Stack consumed due to an activation of Phantom Bullet consumes an additional activation of Phantom Bullet.

passive.ability2: Increase DEF by 20% when under a DMG barrier.
passive.ability3: When own HP is above 50%, increase ATK by 50%. When own HP is below 50%, increase DMG RES by 20%.

trueweapon.name: Barbatos
trueweapon.skill: 60s CT - 12000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 15s, reduce Enemies' PHY RES by 20%. If user is Earth, reduce Enemies' PHY RES by 30% instead.

passive.ability1: Increase own Skill CT REC by 10%.
passive.ability2: When equipped by Vultee (Earth), increase DMG RES by 10%, and increase Paralysis and Freeze RES by 100%.

passive.ability1: When Near-Death, increase own DMG RES by 20%.
passive.ability2: Increase Earth allies' Arts by 2/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.

passive.ability1: Change Phantom Bullet's DMG Multiplier per Bullet stack from 50000% to 80000% instead.
passive.ability2: When own HP is 80% or above, increase own Arts by 3/s.
